title: Labor Rights & Employment
description: Quiz on labor protections, workplace standards, and employment regulations in Nepal.

questions.question: Which principle underpins fair labor standards?
questions.explanation: Decent work encapsulates fair wages, safety, and dignity.

questions.question: Select protections typically included in labor rights.
questions.explanation: Labor rights include safety, unions, and bargaining; forced unpaid overtime violates standards.

questions.question: True or False: Minimum wage policies help mitigate in-work poverty.
questions.explanation: Minimum wages set a floor that can reduce extreme low pay.

questions.question: Which factor strengthens enforcement of labor rights?
questions.explanation: Transparent monitoring and penalties improve compliance.

questions.question: Which situation signifies disguised employment?
options: Independent label but controlled hours & tools
questions.explanation: Control without formal employment suggests misclassification.

questions.question: Which is a gender equity measure in workplaces?
questions.explanation: Equal pay audits detect and reduce unjustified gaps.

questions.question: Which indicator best evaluates decent work progress?
questions.explanation: Injury rates show workplace safety performance.

questions.question: Select all components that deepen understanding of Labor Rights & Employment.
options: Irrelevant myths unrelated to the topic
questions.explanation: Core concepts, applicable frameworks, and practical examples build robust understanding; unrelated myths do not.

questions.question: Case studies help apply abstract concepts to real situations.
questions.explanation: Applying concepts in realistic contexts strengthens comprehension and recall.

questions.question: Which study approach most improves retention of key ideas?
questions.explanation: Active recall and practice yield better retention than passive reading or cramming.

questions.question: What is a practical way to connect Labor Rights & Employment to real-world decisions?
options: Relate concepts to local news or policies
questions.explanation: Linking concepts to current events and local policies improves understanding and relevance.

questions.question: Select good strategies to evaluate claims about this topic.
options: Rely solely on anonymous social posts
Look for credible data and context
questions.explanation: Verifying against primary sources, mandates, and credible data yields more reliable conclusions.

questions.question: Which practices are explicitly prohibited under labor rights provisions?
questions.explanation: Forced and child labor are prohibited; collective bargaining and inspections are part of rights/enforcement.

questions.question: True or False: Social security can include health, accident, and retirement benefits.
questions.explanation: Nepal’s social security framework typically includes health, accident, and retirement benefits.

questions.question: Which bodies primarily enforce labor rights disputes?
questions.explanation: Labor offices and tribunals handle enforcement and dispute resolution.
